description.zh: 目标实例ID，可调用DescribeInstances接口获取。
description.en: The ID of target instance. You can call the DescribeInstances operation to obtain target instance ID.

description.zh:
账号的新密码，需符合以下要求：
* 至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的任意三种。
* 长度为8~32个字符。
* 特殊字符为`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`。
description.en:
The new password of the account. The password must meet the following requirements:
* Contains at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
* Is 8 to 32 characters in length.
* Special characters include `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbase modify-account-password --cluster-id ld-bp150tns0sjxs0000 --account-name test01 --new-account-password test00000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbase ModifyAccountPassword --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId 'ld-bp150tns0sjxs0000' --NewAccountPassword test00000 --AccountName test01
